english.note: PTE 58. Official scores within two years; qualifying country/recent-degree exemptions. Department may require more.

funding.note: Doctoral students normally hold grant-funded GRAs; availability depends on faculty funds. Mixed GTA support possible. Some nine-month GTAs include tuition; nonresident tuition first year only. No universal guarantee or current stipend amount stated.
